services.name: Shark Fishing
services.desc: Deep Sea Shark Fishing Charters in Destin Florida, “The World’s Luckiest Fishing Village”. Are you ready for an adrenaline rush of a lifetime? O Sea D Fishing Charters will help you with that and catch that big shark! A shark charter with O Sea D allows you to get up close and personal with monster-sized sharks! It is a common misconception that large sharks can only be found in the deeper parts of the Gulf. O Sea D proves that wrong as we catch loads of monster-sized sharks within miles of the shore. blurb: Guests choose their fishing goals and can go trolling or bottom fishing on reefs and wrecks. The fleet includes three center console boats, two state licensed for closer shore fishing and one federally permitted for deep offshore fishing. Private boat tours are also available seasonally for sightseeing and dolphin watching.
